units.source_text: “织女姬的缝纫技术，姑置不论，最好能像她和牛郎那样永缔良缘。

en.t: Leaving aside Lady Weaver's skill at sewing, it would be best if she could form a lasting bond, like the one between her and the Cowherd.

units.source_text: 你那个本领不亚于立田姬的人，实在不可多得啊！

en.t: A woman whose talents are no less than those of Lady Tatsuta is truly hard to find!

units.source_text: 就像变幻无常的春花秋叶，倘色彩不合季节，

en.t: Just like the ever-changing flowers of spring and leaves of autumn, if their colors do not suit the season,

units.source_text: 渲染不得其法，也不会受人欣赏，只得白白地枯死。

en.t: and if they are not colored in the proper way, people will not admire them, and they can only wither away in vain.

units.source_text: 何况才艺兼备的女性，在这世间实在很难求得。

en.t: How much harder, then, it is to find a woman in this world who possesses both talent and accomplishments.
This judging of women is truly no easy matter!"

units.source_text: 他用这话来怂恿，左马头就继续讲下去：

en.t: He encouraged him with these words, and the Captain of the Left Division of the Guards continued:
